input: how do I add someone to my workspace who isn't in my company? like a client
expected:
You can invite them as a guest. Guests are free and can only see the projects you invite them to.
1. Open the project you want to share.
2. Click Share > Invite guest.
3. Enter their email address and choose whether they can view, comment or edit.
They'll get an email invite and won't see anything else in your workspace.

input: I lost my phone and can't log in because of 2FA
expected: Sorry about that. If you saved your recovery codes when you set up 2FA, enter one on the login screen under "Use a recovery code". If not, any admin in your workspace can reset your 2FA in Settings > Members > (your name) > Reset 2FA, and you can set it up again on a new phone. If you're the workspace owner and there's no other admin, reply here and I'll pass it to our team to verify your identity.

input: Getting 'SAML response invalid' when trying to login with SSO. Whole team can't get in!!
expected: Sorry, that's blocking your whole team, so let's move fast. This error usually means the identity provider's certificate or settings no longer match ours, for example after a certificate rotation. I've passed this to our support team as urgent. Please reply with your workspace URL and the identity provider you use. In the meantime, workspace owners can still log in with their email and password at taskline.example/login?sso=0.

input: Can I get a refund? We were charged for 40 seats but only use 25
expected: I understand. Paying for unused seats is frustrating. You can reduce your seat count now in Settings > Billing > Seats, and your next invoice will be lower. I can't issue refunds myself, but I've passed your request for a refund on the unused seats to our billing team, and they'll reply within 1 business day.

input: tasks I deleted yesterday, can i get them back?
expected:
Yes. Deleted tasks stay in Trash for 30 days.
1. Open the project the tasks were in.
2. Click the ... menu at the top right > Trash.
3. Select the tasks and click Restore.
They'll go back to their original board and column.

input: Your app is not loading at all, just a white screen
expected:
Sorry about that. First, check status.taskline.example to see if there's an incident in progress. If everything there is green, try:
1. A hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R, or Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac).
2. A private window or another browser.
3. Temporarily disabling browser extensions, especially ad blockers.
If it's still blank, tell me your browser and version, and send a screenshot of the developer console (F12 > Console) if you can.

input: How do I connect Slack so my team gets notified when tasks are assigned
expected:
Here's how:
1. Go to Settings > Integrations > Slack and click Connect.
2. Approve access in Slack.
3. Choose a Slack channel for each project, or let members turn on personal notifications in their own profile settings.
Assignments, comments and due-date reminders can be switched on or off for each project.

input: Do you have a Gantt chart view? We need one for client reporting
expected: Yes, on the Business and Enterprise plans there's a Timeline view that works like a Gantt chart. Open a project and choose View > Timeline, then drag tasks to set dates and dependencies. You can export it as a PDF or share a read-only link with clients. On the Team plan, the Calendar view is the closest option.

input: I need to export all our data before we leave
expected: You can export everything yourself. Go to Settings > Workspace > Export and choose CSV (good for spreadsheets) or JSON (complete, including comments and attachments links). You'll get an email when the export is ready, which can take up to an hour for large workspaces. Only admins and the owner can run an export.

input: We think someone who left the company still has access and downloaded files
expected: Thanks for flagging this. We take it seriously. First, remove their access now in Settings > Members > (their name) > Deactivate. I've passed this to our security team as a possible security incident, and they'll reply within 1 business day, or 4 hours on Business and Enterprise, to help you review activity. Please don't delete anything in the meantime, so the activity history stays available.

input: hey when will you add dark mode?? been asking for a year lol
expected: Thanks for your patience, and for keeping at it! I can't share release dates, but I've added your vote to the dark mode request so the product team sees it. For now, some customers use their browser's or operating system's force-dark setting as a workaround. It isn't perfect, but it helps in the evenings.

input: Our card failed and now the workspace says suspended. We have a deadline TODAY
expected: Sorry, I know the timing couldn't be worse. To restore access fastest, update the card in Settings > Billing > Payment method. The workspace reactivates automatically once the payment goes through, usually within a few minutes. If the payment keeps failing, I've passed this to our billing team as urgent, and they'll reply within 1 business day, or 4 hours on Business and Enterprise.

input: How do I make a template so every new client project has the same columns and tasks
expected:
Here's how:
1. Set up one project exactly how you want it, with its columns, tasks, checklists and automations.
2. Click the project's ... menu > Save as template.
3. Next time, choose New project > From template.
Templates are shared with your whole workspace, and admins can edit or delete them in Settings > Templates.

input: importing from Jira but it's stuck at 60% for 2 hours
expected: Sorry for the wait. Large Jira imports can take a while, but two hours stuck at 60% suggests it has stalled. Please reply with your workspace URL and roughly how many Jira issues you're importing, and I'll pass it to our team to check the import job. Don't start a second import in the meantime, as it can create duplicate tasks.

input: The CEO left and she was the workspace owner. How do we change ownership?
expected: Ownership transfers need identity checks, so a human handles them. I've passed this to our support team, and they'll reply within 1 business day, or 4 hours on Business and Enterprise. To speed it up, have ready the workspace URL, the email of the new owner (who must already be an admin) and confirmation from someone with billing authority.

input: can i downgrade from Business to Team mid-year
expected: Yes. Go to Settings > Billing > Change plan and pick Team. The change applies immediately, and any unused time on Business becomes a credit on your next invoice. Note that Business-only features, such as the Timeline view and advanced permissions, will switch off, though your data stays.

input: Password reset link says expired
expected: Reset links expire after 1 hour for security. Request a new one on the login page under "Forgot password" and use it within the hour. Use the most recent email, because each new request makes the older links stop working. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or ask your IT team whether external emails are being filtered.

input: automations not firing. set one to move tasks to Done when checkbox ticked, nothing happens
expected:
Let's check the usual causes:
1. Open Project > Automations and make sure the automation is turned on.
2. Check that the trigger is the exact custom field ("Checkbox: Approved = checked").
3. Automations only run on changes made after they were created, not on existing tasks.
If all of that looks right, send me the project link and a screenshot of the automation, and I'll pass it on as a bug.

input: We need you to fill out our vendor security questionnaire and sign a DPA
expected: Happy to help. Our standard DPA and security documents, including our SOC 2 report under NDA, are available on request. I've passed this to our security and legal team with your request, and they'll reply within 1 business day. Please reply with the questionnaire attached and the deadline you're working to.

input: how many people can I have on free plan
expected: The Free plan includes up to 5 members, plus unlimited guests. Guests can only access the projects they're invited to. If you need more members, the Team plan is priced per seat, and you can upgrade any time in Settings > Billing > Change plan.

input: this is useless. the board view freezes every time I drag a card. Chrome, windows 11, workspace acme-design.
expected: Sorry, that's genuinely frustrating. Thanks for including your browser and workspace. A couple of quick checks: does it also freeze in a private window, with extensions off? And roughly how many cards are on that board? Very large boards can slow down dragging. If it still freezes, a short screen recording would help a lot. I'll pass it all to our engineers as a bug.

input: can I see who changed a task's due date?
expected: Yes. Open the task and click the Activity tab. It shows every change, including due dates, who made it and when. Admins on Business and Enterprise can also see changes across the whole workspace in Settings > Audit log.

input: Is my data stored in the EU?
expected: On Business and Enterprise plans, you can choose EU data residency when you create a workspace. Your data is then stored and processed in the EU. On Free and Team, data is stored in the US. If you need an existing workspace moved to the EU, I can pass that request to our team.

input: hi 2 questions: how do I invoice by PO, and how do I remove an old admin
expected:
Sure, here are both.
Paying by purchase order: this is available on annual Business and Enterprise plans. I've passed your request to our billing team, and they'll reply within 1 business day to set it up.
Removing an old admin:
1. Go to Settings > Members.
2. Find the person and click ... > Deactivate.
Their tasks and comments stay, and you can reassign their open tasks from the same menu.

input: GitHub integration links commits to the wrong tasks
expected: Commits are linked when the commit message includes a task ID, such as TL-142. Wrong links usually happen when two workspaces use the same ID prefix, or a message contains several IDs. Check Settings > Integrations > GitHub and confirm the right repository is connected to the right workspace. If that's all correct, send me an example commit message and the task it linked to, and I'll report it.

input: Deleted our workspace by accident!!! please tell me it can be recovered
expected: Don't worry, a deleted workspace can be recovered within 30 days. The workspace owner should log in, and they'll see a banner offering to Restore workspace. If that doesn't appear, I've passed this to our support team as urgent, and they'll reply within 1 business day, or 4 hours on Business and Enterprise. Please don't create a new workspace with the same name in the meantime.
